target_source: Original ideal CAD gives 6.000 mm projected flexible-pad gap and native BRep gives 6.00666 mm at this coordinate. User reported approximate 6 mm flexible and 8 mm rigid openings; this is not motor/encoder/as-built calibration.
reported_rigid_definition_uncertainty: At this coordinate native gaps are 10.01551 mm between pad carriers, 8.39080 mm between L links, and 6.72901 mm between blades. The user's approximate rigid opening does not specify which pair was measured.
alternative_housing_pocket: Same approximate radial clearance would leave about 0.918 mm of a 1.5 mm housing wall; the selected lug cut retains about 1.918 mm to the unchanged 1.5 mm-radius pin hole. These are geometric comparisons, not strength validations.
mechanical_validation: No FEA, fatigue, stiffness, printed-material or hardware load validation. No claim that the experimental copy matches the built mechanism.
